ctx.x: So we don't have to carry no -- the guys carried their horns and didn't have to carry no bass and I didn't have to carry no drums. We play this party, Jack Hilton played till we got there. So we go in this party, we come in this party -- this is God's honest truth, this is not no illusion. This is the real thing. We come in this party and the place is crowded. At that time Jeannette McDonald, she was a big star, you know, she sang --

She was there as a guest. Anna Mae Wong, remember her, some movie star and a gang of American movie stars, so we pop in there. I will never forget it. We were all dressed in white because it was in the summer, you know, in July, we had on white uniforms and special made, white special made shoes, all sharp, so this guy that's married to the Queen now, he grabbed Duke right away and sit him down at the piano stool and they start playing -- see, he play piano and start playing and Duke, wait a minute -- he say, 'I…
